[h2][b]Intro[/b][/h2]
Welcome to Nyanco Channel! Whoever fights monsters should see to it that in the process that one does not become a monster. Moreover, should one gaze long enough into the abyss, the abyss will gaze back into you.

[h2][b]About This Game[/b][/h2]
Welcome to your new part time job at Nyanco Channel where many followers alike come to enjoy her video entertainment! Be aware though that there are hidden secrets on this channel that you don't know yet. While working your job for 3 days at Nyanco Channel from your small office you must remember to do many things. Things such as checking the CCTVs to watch for irregular activity, remembering to use your flashlight and opening and closing your door when the situation calls for it. You must stay safe and vigilant from 12 A.M. to 6 A.M. Can you survive three nights at Nyanco Channel?

[h2][b]Features[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]Anime/Doujin inspired art and themes
[*]High replayabilty value through random events
[*]Highly recommended for Nyanco Channel followers
[*]Special ending rewards include illustrations of Nyanco-chan
[*]Parodies of popular works you may or may not be familiar with
[/list]

[h2][b]Game Engine[/b][/h2]
RPG Maker MV (by KADOKAWA / Degica)

[h2][b]Disclaimer[/b][/h2]
All characters in Nyanco Channel are fictional. Any resemblance to persons living or dead or the real world is purely coincidental.

[h2][b]Special Thanks[/b][/h2]
Alice, nashix, Holy Lightning, HaZE, Scott, ParanoX, Ruko, EinMeister, Azusa and You!

notes.title: How to Get Steam Achievements
notes.notes:
Hi Nyancos! (/≧▽≦)/

Do you want Steam Achievements in Nyanco? (ฅ'ω'ฅ)
Here is the way to activate that function in this game.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35265523/12922c3d2fb5797a024db86b6736a3cdc1e4da99.png[/img]

1. On the Steam client, search for "Nyanco" and right-click. Then select Properties.

2. Opt for the Nyanco_Steam_Achievements_Ver on the BETA tab! ε-(•́ω•̀๑)

3. If it has been successfully applied, [achievements] will be displayed next to Nyanco.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35265523/8f1a3fe9142e2ee87ed3e059529e2de5d5178c84.png[/img]

Nyanco BETA build is a little unstable. 
But you can do it, Nyanco Player! ヽ(=^･ω･^=)丿
